subject: MAP: evaluation window compression + procurement hold — action ledger
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Turner <mike@clearpath.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP — evaluation window compression and procurement hold

Hi Mike / Jenna,

Thanks for the heads up — appreciate the transparency. I pulled the MAP and timeline and can see how the procurement queue and the additional security questionnaire introduce schedule risk. Attached is an updated action ledger (MAP_v1.pdf) that splits the evaluation into two parallel lanes: a lightweight proof-of-concept sandbox for your dev team (can start within 48h) and the full acceptance run once procurement clears.

Proposed short-term mitigations:
- Start sandbox (2 dev seats) with token-limited access and monitoring (no production data).
- Provide a short SOC2 evidence bundle and a technical test harness so your security team can validate quickly.
- Hold the formal acceptance window until procurement clears, but keep rolling canaries so dev momentum isn't lost.

Ask: can you confirm by EOD today whether Clearpath wants the sandbox started (we can provision by tomorrow) and whether procurement expects a hard hold date or a soft target? If we get a firm date we’ll update the MAP milestones and credit proposal accordingly.

Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf) — contains milestone dates, ownership, and the proposed sandbox configuration.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. Short version: procurement flagged two blockers this morning:
1) Additional vendor security questionnaire (they want deeper KMS/HSM details and retention matrix) — we won’t get answers back until legal and InfoSec meet (likely 8/18).
2) Budget owner is out next week and indicated they prefer to move signature to after the month close.

Given that, procurement is asking us to pause formal acceptance activities until mid-August. That said, the dev team still wants to keep going — they asked if we can run a limited sandbox and give them a small test dataset and a smoke harness. They also asked for any SOC2 artifacts and a short statement on data handling so they can attach to the questionnaire.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a condensed SOC2 evidence bundle and a one-page data retention matrix?
- If procurement needs a buffer past 8/18, would Redwood consider a two-week extension to the MAP with a small trial credit?

I’ve attached the procurement notice form they sent over.

—Mike

Subject: Fwd: MAP — evaluation window compression and procurement hold — internal triage

Team —

Brief triage notes after chatting with Jordan:
- Risk: procurement timeline moved to ~2027-08-18 (hard) per Clearpath legal/infosec signal. This breaks the original MAP acceptance milestone and introduces a two-week slip on the critical path.
- Impact: potential revenue deferral to next fiscal month and risk of losing dev momentum if sandbox not provisioned immediately.

Recommended mitigations (quick, low-friction):
1) Approve provisioning of a sandbox environment immediately (48h) with 2 dev seats and strict token caps. No customer data in sandbox.
2) Provide condensed SOC2 evidence and a one-page data retention matrix — Sales Ops can assemble from the control room.
3) Offer a one-time trial credit of $10k to offset their procurement timing (credit applies to first month of usage after go-live).
4) Update MAP milestones and produce an action ledger that records dates and owners; mark procurement as the gating risk and create an escalation path to execs if 8/18 passes without resolution.

I’ve attached a quick credit calc and decision matrix for signoff. If we agree, Jordan — please share the updated MAP and credit letter with Clearpath.

Attachment: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales — Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0064

Subject: Re: MAP — evaluation window compression and procurement hold 

Mike / Jenna —

Thanks for the detail and the form. We can absolutely help keep the evaluation moving without requiring Clearpath to sign today. Agreed plan below: 

Confirmed mitigations (Redwood):
- Provision sandbox within 48 hours (2 dev seats, token-limited, audit-only logging).
- Deliver a condensed SOC2 evidence bundle and a one-page retention matrix (link below).
- Issue a one-time $10,000 trial credit that will apply to the first invoice after formal go-live. Credit letter attached.
- Updated MAP attached with new milestone dates and clear owners; procurement is marked as gating risk.

We’ll treat the procurement hold as a gating risk in the MAP and continue rolling canaries so the dev team can validate integrations. If procurement remains unresolved past 2027-08-18 we’ll escalate to Sales leadership and legal as documented in the action ledger.

Next steps for Clearpath:
1) Confirm sandbox start by reply ("Start Sandbox: YES") — we’ll provision within 48h.
2) If procurement has a projected slack > 2 weeks, please flag so we can consider additional runway/credits.

Attachments: MAP_v1_revA.pdf (application/pdf), Credit_Letter_Clearpath.pdf (application/pdf)
